title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Private Hours (He's Not Watching to Catch You)
caption:
What Scripture actually says about your private hours: God isn't watching to catch you. He's already there.

He knows you fully. What you hide grows. What you confess starts to die. And the hours no one sees are where He builds you.

What would you say to Him tonight if you stopped hiding?
